verses.en: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,
verses.pt: Então Jesus voltou a lhes falar por parábolas, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, talking to them again in stories, said:

verses.en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,
verses.pt: O reino dos céus é semelhante a um rei que fez uma festa de casamento para o seu filho;
verses.en_web: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a marriage feast for his son,
verses.en_bbe: The kingdom of heaven is like a certain king, who made a feast when his son was married,

verses.en: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.
verses.pt: e mandou a seus servos que chamassem os convidados para a festa de casamento, mas não quiseram vir.
verses.en_web: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the marriage feast, but they would not come.
verses.en_bbe: And sent out his servants to get in the guests to the feast: and they would not come.

verses.en: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.
verses.pt: Outra vez ele mandou outros servos, dizendo: “Dizei aos convidados: ‘Eis que já preparei meu jantar: meus bois e animais cevados já foram mortos, e tudo está pronto. Vinde à festa de casamento’”.
verses.en_web: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the marriage feast!”’
verses.en_bbe: Again he sent out other servants, with orders to say to the guests, See, I have made ready my feast: my oxen and my fat beasts have been put to death, and all things are ready: come to the feast.

verses.en: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:
verses.pt: Porém eles não deram importância e foram embora, um ao seu campo, e outro ao seu comércio;
verses.en_web: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise,
verses.en_bbe: But they gave no attention, and went about their business, one to his farm, another to his trade:

verses.en: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.
verses.pt: e outros agarraram os servos dele, e os humilharam e os mataram.
verses.en_web: and the rest grabbed his servants, and treated them shamefully, and killed them.
verses.en_bbe: And the rest put violent hands on his servants, and did evil to them, and put them to death.

verses.en: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
verses.pt: Quando o rei Então enviou os seus exércitos, destruiu aqueles homicidas, e incendiou a cidade deles.
verses.en_web: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.
verses.en_bbe: But the king was angry; and he sent his armies, and those who had put his servants to death he gave to destruction, burning down their town with fire.

verses.en: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.
verses.pt: Em seguida, disse aos seus servos: “Certamente a festa de casamento está pronta, porém os convidados não eram dignos.
verses.en_web: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.
verses.en_bbe: Then he said to his servants, The feast is ready but the guests were not good enough.

verses.en: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.
verses.pt: Ide, pois, às saídas dos caminhos, e convidai à festa de casamento tantos quantos achardes.
verses.en_web: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the marriage feast.’
verses.en_bbe: Go then to the cross-roads, and get all those whom you see to come to the bride-feast.

verses.en: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.
verses.pt: Aqueles servos saíram pelos caminhos, e ajuntaram todos quantos acharam, tanto maus como bons; e a festa de casamento se encheu de convidados.
verses.en_web: Those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.
verses.en_bbe: And those servants went out into the streets, and got together all those whom they came across, bad and good: and the feast was full of guests.

verses.en: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:
verses.pt: Mas quando o rei entrou para ver os convidados, percebeu ali um homem que não estava vestido com roupa adequada para a festa de casamento.
verses.en_web: But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,
verses.en_bbe: But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who had not on a guest's robe;

verses.en: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.
verses.pt: Então lhe perguntou: “Amigo, como entraste aqui sem ter roupa para a festa?” E ele emudeceu.
verses.en_web: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.
verses.en_bbe: And he says to him, Friend, how came you in here not having a guest's robe? And he had nothing to say.

verses.en: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.pt: Então o rei disse aos servos: “Amarrai-o nos pés e nas mãos, tomai-o, e lançai-o nas trevas de fora. Ali haverá pranto e o ranger de dentes”.
verses.en_web: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’
verses.en_bbe: Then the king said to the servants, Put cords round his hands and feet and put him out into the dark; there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.

verses.en: For many are called, but few are chosen.
verses.pt: Pois muitos são chamados, porém poucos escolhidos.
verses.en_web: For many are called, but few chosen.”
verses.en_bbe: For out of all to whom the good news has come, only a small number will get salvation.

verses.en: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
verses.pt: Então os fariseus foram embora, e se reuniram para tramar como o apanhariam em cilada por algo que dissesse.
verses.en_web: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.
verses.en_bbe: Then the Pharisees went and had a meeting to see how they might make use of his words to take him.

verses.en: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.
verses.pt: Depois lhe enviaram seus discípulos, juntamente com os apoiadores de Herodes, e perguntaram: Mestre, bem sabemos que tu és verdadeiro, e que com verdade ensinas o caminho de Deus, e que não te importas com a opinião de ninguém, porque não dás atenção à aparência humana.
verses.en_web: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach, for you aren’t partial to anyone.
verses.en_bbe: And they sent to him their disciples, with the Herodians, saying, Master, we see that you are true, and that you are teaching the true way of God, and have no fear of anyone, because you have no respect for a man's position.

verses.en: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?
verses.pt: Dize-nos, pois, o que te parece: é lícito dar tributo a César, ou não?
verses.en_web: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”
verses.en_bbe: Give us, then, your opinion of this: Is it right to give tax to Caesar, or not?

verses.en: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?
verses.pt: Mas Jesus, entendendo a sua malícia, disse: Por que me tentais, hipócritas?
verses.en_web: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?
verses.en_bbe: But Jesus saw their trick and said, Oh false ones, why are you attempting to put me in the wrong?

verses.en: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.
verses.pt: Mostrai-me a moeda do tributo.E eles lhe trouxeram um denário.
verses.en_web: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.
verses.en_bbe: Let me see the tax money. And they gave him a penny.

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
verses.pt: E ele lhes perguntou: De quem é esta imagem, e a inscrição?
verses.en_web: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Whose is this image and name on it?

verses.en: They say unto him, Caesar’s. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar’s; and unto God the things that are God’s.
verses.pt: Eles lhe responderam: De César. Então ele lhes disse: Dai, pois, a César o que é de César, e a Deus o que é de Deus.
verses.en_web: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
verses.en_bbe: They say to him, Caesar's. Then he said to them, Give to Caesar the things which are Caesar's, and to God the things which are God's.

verses.en: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
verses.pt: Quando ouviram isso, eles ficaram admirados; então o deixaram e se retiraram.
verses.en_web: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him, and went away.
verses.en_bbe: And hearing it, they were full of wonder, and went away from him.

verses.en: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
verses.pt: Naquele mesmo dia chegaram a ele os saduceus, que dizem não haver ressurreição, e perguntaram-lhe,
verses.en_web: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,
verses.en_bbe: On the same day there came to him the Sadducees, who say that there is no coming back from the dead: and they put a question to him, saying,

verses.en: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.pt: dizendo: Mestre, Moisés disse: Se um homem morrer sem ter filhos, seu irmão se casará com sua mulher, e gerará descendência ao seu irmão. Deuteronômio 25:5
verses.en_web: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up offspring for his brother.’
verses.en_bbe: Master, Moses said, If a man, at the time of his death, has no children, let his brother take his wife, and get a family for his brother;

verses.en: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:
verses.pt: Ora, havia entre nós sete irmãos. O primeiro se casou, e depois morreu; e sem ter tido filhos, deixou sua mulher ao seu irmão.
verses.en_web: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.
verses.en_bbe: Now there were among us seven brothers; and the first was married and at his death, having no seed, gave his wife to his brother;

verses.en: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.
verses.pt: E da mesma maneira também foi com o segundo, o terceiro, até os sete.
verses.en_web: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.
verses.en_bbe: In the same way the second and the third, up to the seventh.

verses.en: And last of all the woman died also.
verses.pt: Por último, depois de todos, a mulher também morreu.
verses.en_web: After them all, the woman died.
verses.en_bbe: And last of all the woman came to her end.

verses.en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
verses.pt: Assim, na ressurreição, a mulher será de qual dos sete? Pois todos a tiveram.
verses.en_web: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”
verses.en_bbe: When they come back from the dead, then, whose wife will she be of the seven? because they all had her.

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
verses.pt: Jesus, porém, lhes respondeu: Errais, por não conhecerdes as Escrituras, nem o poder de Deus.
verses.en_web: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.
verses.en_bbe: But Jesus said to them in answer, You are in error, not having knowledge of the Writings, or of the power of God.

verses.en: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.
verses.pt: Porque na ressurreição, nem se tomam, nem se dão em casamento; mas são como os anjos de Deus no céu.
verses.en_web: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.
verses.en_bbe: For when they come back from the dead there are no husbands and wives, but they are as the angels in heaven.

verses.en: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
verses.pt: E sobre a ressurreição dos mortos, não lestes o que Deus vos falou:
verses.en_web: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,
verses.en_bbe: But about the dead coming back to life, have you no knowledge of what was said to you by God in the Writings:

verses.en: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
verses.pt: Eu sou o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque, e o Deus de Jacó? Êxodo 3:6 Deus não é Deus dos mortos, mas sim dos vivos!
verses.en_web: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?’ God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”
verses.en_bbe: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead but of the living.

verses.en: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.
verses.pt: Quando as multidões ouviram isto,ficaram admiradas de sua doutrina.
verses.en_web: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.
verses.en_bbe: And the people hearing it were surprised at his teaching.

verses.en: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
verses.pt: E os fariseus, ao ouvirem que ele havia feito os saduceus se calarem, reuniram-se.
verses.en_web: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.
verses.en_bbe: But the Pharisees, hearing how the mouths of the Sadducees had been stopped, came together;

verses.en: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
verses.pt: E um deles, especialista da Lei, tentando-o, perguntou-lhe:
verses.en_web: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.
verses.en_bbe: And one of them, a teacher of the law, put a question to him, testing him, and saying,

verses.en: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
verses.pt: Mestre, qual é o grande mandamento na Lei?
verses.en_web: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”
verses.en_bbe: Master, which is the chief rule in the law?

verses.en: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
verses.pt: E Jesus lhe respondeu: Amarás ao Senhor teu Deus com todo o teu coração, com toda a tua alma, e com todo o teu entendimento: Deuteronômio 6:5
verses.en_web: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’
verses.en_bbe: And he said to him, Have love for the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind.

verses.en: This is the first and great commandment.
verses.pt: este é o primeiro e grande mandamento.
verses.en_web: This is the first and great commandment.
verses.en_bbe: This is the first and greatest rule.

verses.en: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.pt: E o segundo, semelhante a este, é: Amarás o teu próximo como a ti mesmo. Levítico 19:18
verses.en_web: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
verses.en_bbe: And a second like it is this, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself.

verses.en: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
verses.pt: Destes dois mandamentos dependem toda a Lei e os Profetas.
verses.en_web: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”
verses.en_bbe: On these two rules all the law and the prophets are based.

verses.en: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
verses.pt: E, estando os fariseus reunidos, Jesus lhes perguntou,
verses.en_web: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,
verses.en_bbe: Now while the Pharisees were together, Jesus put a question to them, saying,

verses.en: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David.
verses.pt: dizendo: Que pensais vós acerca do Cristo? De quem ele é filho? Eles lhe responderam: De Davi.
verses.en_web: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”
verses.en_bbe: What is your opinion of the Christ? whose son is he? They say to him, The Son of David.

verses.en: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,
verses.pt: Jesus lhes disse: Como, pois, Davi, em espírito, o chama Senhor, dizendo:
verses.en_web: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,
verses.en_bbe: He says to them, How then does David in the Spirit give him the name of Lord, saying,

verses.en: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?
verses.pt: Disse o Senhor a meu Senhor: “Senta-te à minha direita, até que eu ponha os teus inimigos como estrado de teus pés”. Salmos 110:1
verses.en_web: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet?’
verses.en_bbe: The Lord said to my Lord, Be seated at my right hand, till I put under your feet all those who are against you?

verses.en: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?
verses.pt: Ora, se Davi o chama Senhor, como é seu filho?
verses.en_web: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”
verses.en_bbe: If David then gives him the name of Lord, how is he his son?

verses.en: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
verses.pt: E ninguém podia lhe responder palavra; nem ninguém ousou desde aquele dia a mais lhe perguntar.
verses.en_web: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.
verses.en_bbe: And no one was able to give him an answer, and so great was their fear of him, that from that day no one put any more questions to him.
